Season is roughly late May to late Sep; most tents pack up by late Sep/early Oct (DwD).

taxi_day.basis: Leh union card FY2025-26 (see Pangong basis): the card's 'Drass War Memorial 1 day / 2 days' rows (card p.8). No Drass- or Kargil-based local fare found, so local_sightseeing_8h_inr is null on purpose. Srinagar operators do not list Drass or Zojila (they say union taxis cover those).
taxi_day.notes: Union extras (card p.23): night halt 385/night; AC on demand 9/km paid to driver; waiting free for 1st hour then 345/hr; extra day on a hire = 3,407 full day (8 h) or 1,703 half day (Innova class; Fortuner 4,122/2,060, Crysta 3,747/1,873, Xylo/Scorpio/Ertiga 3,237/1,618, Eeco/Van 2,935/1,470); 50% advance on long routes. Taxis from outside Ladakh cannot do local sightseeing. Permit is separate (EDF about 400 + 20/day + optional 50 per person). The memorial itself is on NH-1, free entry, closed Sundays, so most visitors stop on the Srinagar-Leh drive instead of hiring a separate cab.

food_per_person_day.basis: Same DwD Kargil War Memorial guide (page upd. 20 Sep 2026) combined 'Kargil/Drass' row: meals per day 400-600 budget, 800-1,200 mid-range; midpoints used. Drass has few restaurants (dhabas around the memorial and village), so Kargil (55 km) figures are the proxy.
food_per_person_day.notes: No Drass-specific menu or Zomato page found. Estimate from one author's range.
